info.title: help-to-save-api
info.description: Microservice behind the HMRC API Platform `individuals/help-to-save` API (version 2.0). Lets third-party applications check Help to Save eligibility, create accounts and read account details on behalf of a Government Gateway user (user-restricted) or as a privileged application. Paths below are as served by the microservice; on the API Platform they are prefixed with `/individuals/help-to-save`. Derived from conf/*.routes, controllers, services, validators and models of this repository.

get.description:
Proxied to **help-to-save** as `GET /help-to-save/eligibility-check?nino={nino}`.

Auth: Government Gateway only (privileged → 403); NINO from auth.

First calls `GET /help-to-save/enrolment-status?nino=`; if the user is already enrolled returns `{"accountExists":true}` without an eligibility check (result not cached). Otherwise the eligibility result is cached for 1 hour under the generated correlation id. Every response produced after authentication carries an `X-Correlation-ID` header, which must be sent as `header.requestCorrelationId` in a later create-account request.

Request headers used: `Authorization`, `Accept`, `Gov-Client-User-ID`, `Gov-Client-Timezone`, `Gov-Vendor-Version`, `Gov-Vendor-Instance-ID`.

get.description:
Proxied to **help-to-save** as `GET /help-to-save/eligibility-check?nino={nino}`.

Auth: Government Gateway (path NINO must equal auth NINO) or Privileged Application (any NINO).

Same flow as `GET /eligibility`, but the NINO comes from the path. Returns `X-Correlation-ID`.

Request headers used: `Authorization`, `Accept`, `Gov-Client-User-ID`, `Gov-Client-Timezone`, `Gov-Vendor-Version`, `Gov-Vendor-Instance-ID`.

post.description:
Proxied to **help-to-save** as `POST /help-to-save/create-account`.

Auth: Government Gateway with confidence level ≥ 200 (NINO bound to auth) or Privileged Application.

Checks the cached eligibility for `header.requestCorrelationId` (must exist, belong to the same NINO and be eligible) and, if bank details are supplied, validates them via `POST /help-to-save/validate-bank-details` (in parallel). If communicationPreference is 02 the email is first stored via `GET /help-to-save/store-email`. If the cached result says an account already exists, returns 409 without calling the back end.

Request headers used: `Authorization`, `Accept`, `Content-Type`, `Gov-Client-User-ID`, `Gov-Client-Timezone`, `Gov-Vendor-Version`, `Gov-Vendor-Instance-ID`.

requestBody.description: Create-account request (header + body). Read with `request.body.asJson`; a non-JSON body gives 400 NO_JSON.

401.description: No active session (empty body), or `Insufficient confidence level` (text/plain) for Government Gateway users below L200.

Proxied to **help-to-save** as `GET /help-to-save/{nino}/account?systemId=MDTP-API-client&correlationId={uuid}`.

get.description: Unauthenticated. The only content under /public is the API specification.

bearerAuth.description: Bearer token issued by the API Platform; validated by the auth service with providers GovernmentGateway or PrivilegedApplication.

code.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, NO_JSON, ACCESS_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_CREDENTIALS_PROVIDER, SERVER_ERROR or MISSING_DATA.

FrameworkError.description: Body produced by the bootstrap JsonErrorHandler (body-parser failures, uncaught exceptions).

hasWTC.description: In receipt of Working Tax Credit.

EligibilityResponse.description: Either `{"eligibility": {...}, "accountExists": false}` or `{"accountExists": true}` (no eligibility object).

headroom.description: Amount that can still be paid in this month (upstream `canPayInThisMonth`).

requestCorrelationId.description: The `X-Correlation-ID` returned by a successful eligibility check for the same NINO within the last hour.

ContactDetails.description: address1, address2, postcode and communicationPreference are required once any fill-in from auth has been applied.

communicationPreference.description: 02 = email (email then required and validated); 00 = post.

phoneNumber.description: Must contain a digit, no letters; allowed specials ( ) - . + space.

sortCode.description: Separators (space, -, _, en/em dash, minus sign) are stripped before use.

CreateAccountBody.description: For privileged access nino, forename, surname, dateOfBirth and contactDetails are all required. For user-restricted (Government Gateway) access, missing nino, forename, surname, dateOfBirth and address are filled in from the user's auth record; nino, if given, must equal the auth NINO.

forename.description: No digits, no apostrophe, no leading or consecutive special characters; allowed specials - & . ,

surname.description: No digits, no leading/trailing or consecutive special characters; allowed specials - & . , '

BadRequest.description: Validation failure (`ApiError` with code VALIDATION_ERROR or NO_JSON). Malformed JSON is rejected by the body parser with a `FrameworkError` body.

Unauthorized.description: No active session / missing or invalid bearer token (empty body).

Forbidden.description: Authorisation failure (empty body), unsupported credentials provider (`UNSUPPORTED_CREDENTIALS_PROVIDER`), or NINO mismatch / missing NINO (`ACCESS_ERROR` or empty body).

ServerError.description: Back-end failure (`ApiError` SERVER_ERROR / MISSING_DATA), auth service internal error (empty body), or uncaught exception (`FrameworkError`).

PayloadTooLarge.description: Body larger than the Play body-parser limit (framework default, not overridden).
